subject: SummitBridge co-host demo — capacity & calendar adjustment
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@summitbridge.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Lang <michael.lang@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 13:12:00 -0500
Subject: SummitBridge x Redwood — co-host demo week of Jan 11

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for agreeing to co-host the joint marketplace demo during the week of Jan 11. We have a 45-minute slot reserved on Jan 12 at 10:30am ET, but our SI lead just flagged a conflict — they need a slightly later time to accommodate APAC engineering.

Can Redwood do 1:30pm ET instead? The audience will include: SummitBridge sales+solutions (8 people), AWS SA Michael Lang, and two SI engineers (remote APAC). We want a short 10-minute intro, 25-minute product walk-through with Q&A, then a 10-minute next-steps summary.

We'd also like Redwood to share a one-page runbook and any slide deck or example prompts you plan to demo. We can host the recording in our marketplace listing afterwards.

Attachments: summitbridge_demo_slots.csv (we attached the week grid)

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Program Manager, SummitBridge Solutions
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@summitbridge.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SummitBridge x Redwood — co-host demo week of Jan 11

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the heads up. 1:30pm ET on Jan 12 should work on our side, but I want to confirm a couple things before we lock it:

- Is the target audience more sales-focused or technical? (We can pivot the demo depth.)
- Will we need to route requests through a dedicated Redwood Dedicated instance, or is hosted API okay for this demo?
- Can you confirm the final attendee list and whether the SI engineers will be asked to show any integration code or just observe?

Vanessa — can you prepare a one-page runbook draft (timeouts, fallback model variant, recording consent language) we can send back to Priya today?

Karthik — please flag if we need to reserve Dedicated capacity for 1:30–2:30pm ET on Jan 12 (SB-2026-089).

I’ll tentatively accept 1:30pm ET. If I don’t hear back by EOD tomorrow I’ll lock in the time and share invites.

— Rafael Mendes
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@summitbridge.com>, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SummitBridge x Redwood — co-host demo week of Jan 11

Priya, Rafael —

Draft runbook attached (redwood_runbook_draft_v1.pdf). It includes: intro script, slide order, demo prompts, two fallback model variants (smaller quantized model if latency spikes), and an ops contact for the live session.

Notes for the session:
- We'll plan for hosted API by default; if the SI requires a dedicated instance for performance testing, Karthik, can you confirm availability?
- We recommend recording to SummitBridge Drive and publishing to the marketplace listing after approvals.
- Please confirm whether the SI engineers will need any pre-demo test accounts.

Happy to hop on a quick 15-min run-through the week prior.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_runbook_draft_v1.pdf
From: Michael Lang <michael.lang@amazon.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@summitbridge.com>, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SummitBridge x Redwood — co-host demo week of Jan 11

Hey all —

Quick note from the AWS side: the APAC SI engineers surfaced that 1:30pm ET is late evening for them and their testing window is limited the next day. Would Jan 13 at 10:00am ET work as a compromise? That gives APAC a morning window and keeps NA attendees in a decently sized slot.

If SummitBridge prefers to keep Jan 12, we can also have the SI join only for the Q&A portion and run an internal dry-run with them at a separate time.

Let me know what you prefer and I’ll update the co-host calendar invite.

— Michael Lang
AWS Partner Solutions Architect
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@summitbridge.com>, Michael Lang <michael.lang@amazon.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 16:43:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SummitBridge x Redwood — co-host demo week of Jan 11

All —

Thanks for the fast responses. Consensus plan:
1) Move the public co-host demo to Jan 13, 2027 at 10:00am ET to accommodate APAC SI availability (Michael will update the invite).
2) Redwood will provide runbook + slides (attached) and a short recording consent blurb to include in the invite.
3) If SI wants to validate integrations pre-demo, we’ll schedule a 30-minute dry-run with them on Jan 11 or 12 — Vanessa, please coordinate with Priya and Michael on exact timing.
4) Karthik: please confirm Dedicated capacity hold for Jan 13 09:45–11:00 ET in case of load-based switchovers. Mark as pending on SB-2026-089.

Links & artifacts: HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.com/deals/SB-2026-089) and runbook Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRunbook).

Priya — can you confirm attendee list and whether you want the recording saved to SummitBridge Drive or Redwood S3? Once you confirm I’ll finalize the calendar and add the Redwood ops contact.

Appreciate the flexibility — excited to get this live.

— Rafael Mendes
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_runbook_draft_v1.pdf, summitbridge_demo_slots.csv
